posts.title: Editorial 85mm Golden Hour Portrait with Natural Freckles
posts.excerpt: Award-winning Hasselblad H6D-100c studio portrait prompt with customizable lighting angles and skin texture controls.
posts.content:
## The Concept & Lighting Architecture

This portrait prompt is calibrated specifically for **Midjourney v6.0** and **Flux.1 Dev** to eliminate artificial plastic skin rendering. By specifying a prime 85mm focal length and directional golden hour rim lighting, the diffusion engine calculates real optical bokeh rather than synthetic blurs.

:::tip
**Pro Tip for Photographers:** Always add `--style raw` when using Midjourney v6 to disable Midjourney's default saturation boost. This retains authentic micro-skin pores and natural subsurface scattering.
:::

---

### Key Formula & Parameters:
1. **Camera Angle:** Eye-level 85mm medium portrait
2. **Key Lighting:** Low-angle 2800K warm rim light + diffused 5000K fill
3. **Texture Anchor:** Natural micro-freckles, subtle skin pore fidelity
4. **Style Parameter:** `--style raw --v 6.0 --ar 3:4`

:::info
**Compatible AI Models:** Midjourney v6, Flux.1 Schnell/Dev, Google Gemini Imagen 3, Stable Diffusion XL.
:::

---

### Video Masterclass on Portrait Lighting:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ScMzIvxBSi4

---

### Frequently Asked Questions:
:::faq
Q: How do I change the character's eye color or age?
A: Simply click the "Customize" button above or replace the [Subject] variable token with your desired demographics (e.g., "[elder craftsman with silver beard]").
Q: Why does the skin look blurry in low CFG settings?
A: For Flux.1, keep the CFG scale between 3.0 and 3.8. High CFG values cause chromatic noise, while values below 2.5 can soften facial details.
:::
posts.prompt: Cinematic 85mm portrait of [Subject] with natural hyper-detailed skin texture, soft dramatic side [Lighting], muted emerald and warm amber tones, shallow depth of field, award-winning editorial Vogue photography, shot on Hasselblad H6D-100c --ar 3:4 --v 6.0 --style raw

posts.title: Rain-Slicked Neo Tokyo Twilight Alleyway in 35mm Panavision
posts.excerpt: Blade Runner atmospheric aesthetic with holographic neon reflections and wet asphalt textures.
posts.content:
## Achieving True Cyberpunk Atmosphere Without Neon Slop

Most cyberpunk prompts fall into the trap of oversaturated magenta and cyan blurs. This prompt introduces damp atmospheric mist, 35mm optical chromatic aberration, and authentic Japanese kanji typography to anchor the scene in real cinematic world-building.

:::warning
**Avoid High CFG Scales:** Setting CFG scale too high (above 8.0 in SDXL or 4.5 in Flux) will blow out the neon highlights into solid white blocks. Keep highlight roll-off smooth.
:::

---

### Camera & Atmosphere Setup:
- **Lens:** 35mm anamorphic prime, f/2.0 aperture
- **Atmosphere:** Twilight drizzle, micro-water puddles, suspended humid mist
- **Color Grading:** Teal-orange contrast with Kodak Vision3 500T 5219 film stock simulation

:::info
**Recommended Aspect Ratio:** `--ar 16:9` or `--ar 21:9` for anamorphic widescreen panorama.
:::

posts.title: The Ultimate Guide to Astro SSG, Content Collections & Cloudflare Auto-Deploy
posts.excerpt: Learn how to build, optimize, and deploy a zero-cost AI prompt directory on Cloudflare Pages using Astro and Sveltia CMS.
posts.content:
## Why Astro is the #1 Choice for Modern AI Directories

Astro delivers **zero-JavaScript by default**, rendering 100% pure HTML and CSS to the edge. When building content-heavy sites like AI prompt libraries or photo archives, Astro scores a perfect 100/100 on Google Core Web Vitals.

:::tip
**Performance Advantage:** Astro generates static pages at build time. When users browse prompts, pages load in under **50 milliseconds** worldwide via Cloudflare CDN.
:::

---

### Step-by-Step Architecture:

1. **Astro Content Collections:** Schema-validated TypeScript Markdown files in `src/content/posts/*.md`.
2. **Cloudflare Deploy Hooks:** Triggered automatically whenever you click "Publish" in the CMS.
3. **Sveltia / WP-Admin GUI:** Light-speed browser-based editing with real-time markdown and visual blocks.

```typescript
// src/content/config.ts - Type-Safe Astro Content Collection
import { defineCollection, z } from 'astro:content';

const postsCollection = defineCollection({
  type: 'content',
  schema: z.object({
    title: z.string(),
    model: z.string().optional(),
    aspectRatio: z.string().optional(),
    category: z.string(),
    status: z.enum(['draft', 'published']),
    publishedAt: z.date(),
  }),
});

export const collections = { posts: postsCollection };
```

---

### Watch Video Tutorial:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ScMzIvxBSi4

---

### Frequently Asked Questions:
:::faq
Q: How much does Cloudflare Pages cost for 1,000,000 monthly visitors?
A: Cloudflare Pages is 100% free with unlimited bandwidth and 500 free monthly builds.
Q: Can I add custom domain names?
A: Yes, Cloudflare allows you to connect any custom domain with automatic SSL certificates for free.
:::

items.question: How do I copy and customize variable tokens like [Subject] in a prompt?
items.answer: Click the "Customize" button on any prompt card to open the interactive variable switcher. Select or type your subject/lighting, and click "Copy Customized Prompt" to copy the finalized prompt.

items.question: How does the WordPress-grade Auto-Deploy work on Cloudflare Pages?
items.answer: When you click "Save Draft", your changes are saved locally with zero build costs. When you click "Publish", the admin panel triggers your Cloudflare Deploy Hook to build and refresh static Astro HTML in ~2.8 seconds worldwide.

items.question: Is hosting and content management 100% free forever?
items.answer: Yes! Cloudflare Pages offers unlimited bandwidth and global CDN for free, GitHub stores the repository and markdown content for free, and Sveltia CMS / WP-Admin runs 100% client-side in your browser.

items.question: Which AI engines and generators are supported?
items.answer: We support Midjourney v6, Black Forest Labs Flux.1, Google Gemini (Imagen 3), ChatGPT (DALL·E 3), and Stable Diffusion XL.
